rawFindings.title: Incorrect null handling in Encoder.writeObject for { $class: 'xxx', $: null }
rawFindings.explanation: The original code treated an object with a $class string and a $ that is null or undefined specially by writing null. The patch changes to treat any object with null or undefined as a plain null, ignoring the case where $class is a string with $ null. This breaks the expected behavior for inputs where an object has a $class string but its $ property is null, which should emit a null per previous behavior and per tests.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore original null check logic in proto.writeObject: revert line 302 to `if (is.nullOrUndefined(obj) || (is.string(obj.$class) && is.nullOrUndefined(obj.$))) {`

rawFindings.title: Incorrect null object handling in writeObject method
rawFindings.explanation: The condition in Encoder.prototype.writeObject was changed from checking if the object is null or if it is an object with a string $class but null $ value (i.e., (is.string(obj.$class) && is.nullOrUndefined(obj.$))) to only checking if obj is null or undefined.
